**MicnKey Deck v1.0** – Mic + Key, the free floating AI keypad for Windows.

### Install
1. Download **MicnKey-Deck-v1.0.zip** below.
2. Right-click the zip → **Properties** → tick **Unblock** → OK → **Extract All**.
3. Double-click **Install.cmd**. The deck appears at the bottom right (the first start can take 30–60 s while Windows scans the new files).

### What's in it
- Smart **MIC** key that presses Claude / ChatGPT / Gemini's own dictation button, with live states (connecting → speak now → transcribing → draft ready)
- **Send while talking**: stops the mic, waits for the text, sends
- App and folder keys that switch to the window already open, and light up for the app you're in
- **Insert** turns your number pad into the deck
- Point-and-click Settings (English / Tiếng Việt)

Windows 10/11 · no admin rights · runs locally, no telemetry.

**Tested** on Windows 11 with the Claude and ChatGPT desktop apps. Gemini, the teach-the-mic mode, other app languages and other PCs haven't been tested yet, so please open an issue if something misbehaves.
